newsitem.title: USA: Greenspan U.S. House testimony changed to March 5.
newsitem.headline: Greenspan U.S. House testimony changed to March 5.

text.p: The House Banking Committee postponed the second leg of Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan's semiannual monetary policy testimony to March 5 from Thursday, the committee said Monday.
The testimony was postponed because it was in conflict with a joint session of Congress, which Chilean President Eduardo Frei is scheduled to address.
Greenspan was still scheduled to give the first installment of his Humphrey-Hawkins testimony Wednesday before the Senate Banking Committee.
